task.title: Common steps
task.shortdesc: Reusable steps that other tasks pull in by conref. This task is a warehouse and is not published on its own.

step.cmd: Select the region of audio you want to work on.

info.p: Click and drag in the waveform to select a region; the selection is highlighted.

step.cmd: Save the project with FileSave ProjectSave Project.

info.p: saves the project as a single file in the folder you choose; the Save Project dialog suggests your Documents folder.

step.cmd: Turn the playback volume down before you listen.

info.p: A recording can be much louder than you expect; start low and turn it up.
